components.purpose: Provide quiet lifecycle reminders, privacy-safe metadata checks, and causally paired verification state.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Small lifecycle checks compensate for missed verification and handoff steps by requiring one matching tool invocation and stable workspace fingerprint without storing task content.
retirement_criteria: Repeated lifecycle delay exceeds the bounded value of the reminders.
Equivalent verification and handoff coverage exists with lower privacy risk.

components.purpose: Provide bounded role instructions and small graph-shaped coordination for planning, review, testing, research, and maintenance work.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Focused role guidance, adaptive capability routing, deterministic handoffs, and fresh-context checking compensate for context overload and fragile single-loop coordination.
retirement_criteria: A role has no distinct decision or verification responsibility.
Repeated use shows that the role duplicates another active component.

components.purpose: Package reusable task instructions with explicit triggers and verification guidance.
components.compensation_hypothesis: On-demand instructions compensate for repeated domain mistakes while keeping global context small.
retirement_criteria: The trigger is no longer distinct or repeatedly selects the wrong workflow.
The instruction can be replaced by a smaller rule, script, or document.

components.purpose: Check deterministic harness behavior and record bounded trace comparisons.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Repeatable evaluation compensates for self-review blind spots and exposes behavioral regression.
retirement_criteria: A case no longer represents an active invariant or observed failure.
A cheaper deterministic check provides equivalent regression evidence.

components.purpose: Run bounded recurring health, cross-project learning, current concept research, and proposal generation without unattended maintainable-file edits or published runtime task state.
components.compensation_hypothesis: A privacy-bounded weekly loop compensates for slow configuration drift and otherwise lost lessons across separate Codex tasks.

drivers: review of bounded findings, current public sources, and explicit approval proposals
privacy leakage or unbounded repair scope

retirement_criteria: Recurring checks produce no actionable signal across multiple review periods.
The same coverage becomes part of a cheaper explicit maintenance gate.

components.purpose: Document optional context and action connectors while keeping credentials and runtime configuration local.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Purpose-built connectors compensate for incomplete local context when a task needs external state or structured tools.
retirement_criteria: The connector has no active task class or repeats a local capability.
Its permission, reliability, or quota cost exceeds its measured evidence value.

components.purpose: Provide directly runnable checks, records, and maintenance operations for the harness.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Deterministic utilities compensate for repetitive manual steps and make completion evidence reproducible.
retirement_criteria: A utility duplicates a maintained command with the same safety properties.
No active workflow or verification gate references the utility.

components.purpose: Keep stable operating, safety, evidence, and component evolution guidance reviewable.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Durable documentation compensates for cross-session context loss and prevents hidden maintenance conventions.
retirement_criteria: Guidance is superseded and all inbound references have moved.
The document no longer records a distinct invariant or workflow.
